desc:
This game has been moved. IF YOU ARE JOINING FROM THE OLD GAME, YOU STILL HAVE YOUR DATA AND GAMEPASSES!

🪖 Command Authority is a military simulation and roleplay game. Players hold a role in the United States Armed Forces, and deploy on operations in Africa.

⚔️ This is a ROLEPLAY-focused game, not a shooter. Weapon damage is LOW to give players time to communicate and move around under fire. This won't be enjoyable for all players.

💀 This game has permadeath! When you die (or leave), someone else in the server claims your role - it won't be there when you come back.

🎖️ Users are promoted automatically when roles above open up. Climb the ranks to become a Platoon Sergeant, Company Commander, or even the General!

🚨 Rules: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/red-parasol-rules-information/4589819

Original soundtrack by Nicolas Baquero

Some UGC Assets by ARMS RACE APPAREL: https://www.roblox.com/communities/7337414/ARMS-RACE-APPAREL#!/about
